name: Unconstrained UncheckedAccount
description: UncheckedAccount fields bypass Anchor's ownership and type validation, so without an address, owner, seeds, or constraint attribute a caller can substitute an arbitrary account into the instruction.

name: Duplicate Mutable Accounts
description: When there are two or more accounts with mutable data, a check must be in place to ensure mutation of each account is differentiated properly, to avoid unintended data modification of other accounts.

name: Missing Token Mint Constraint
description: Anchor account structs that accept TokenAccount fields without token::mint constraints can allow wrong-mint token accounts to be passed into sensitive flows.

name: Missing Signer Check
description: When an instruction does not verify that a caller signed the transaction, any account may be passed in its place. Anchor proves this with a Signer field, or the handler can check is_signer directly.

name: Missing Transfer Amount Validation
description: Ensure that token transfers validate the amount being transferred. Transfers should not allow negative values or amounts exceeding the account balance.

name: PDA Sharing
description: Reuse of a PDA across multiple authority domains can lead to unauthorized data or funds access.

name: Arbitrary Cross-Program Invocation
description: If not validated properly, when a program implements a Cross-Program Invocation, callers of the program may provide an arbitrary or untrusted program - manipulating the program to call instructions on an untrusted target program.

name: Division Before Multiplication
description: Performing division before multiplication causes precision loss due to truncation, leading to incorrect calculations in financial operations.

name: Invoke Signed Unvalidated Seeds
description: invoke_signed lends the program's PDA signature to a cross-program invocation. When the target program or account keys derive from caller-supplied accounts without a require_keys_eq check, an attacker can redirect the signed invocation to a malicious target.

name: Missing Freeze Authority Check
description: Programs that accept token deposits without verifying the mint freeze_authority is None allow token issuers to freeze user accounts and trap deposited funds.

name: Missing Token Mint Constraint

name: Unchecked Close Target
description: Anchor close constraints that direct lamports to an unvalidated target can let attackers choose an arbitrary beneficiary when the close target is not proven to be the legitimate owner.

name: Account Data Matching
description: Unpacking account structures without verifying authorization might allow an attacker to view or modify account data unintentionally. Therefore, account unpack operations should be accompanied by appropriate ownership verification.

name: Random Authority Generation
description: Detects generation of random/unique Pubkey for authority which bypasses proper authority validation.

name: Type Cosplay
description: Type cosplay vulnerability occurs when a program fails to validate that an account is of the expected type, allowing malicious accounts to masquerade as legitimate program accounts.

name: Unchecked Arithmetics
description: Arithmetic operations without overflow checks can lead to unexpected behavior, incorrect calculations, or security vulnerabilities when values exceed their maximum limits.
